scope: Source-level Hanlin selection granularity parity; not mounted UIKit execution
findings: Baseline selectedIDs accepts block selection and simple table selected block IDs; text cursor character ranges are not captured in this host context.
Baseline project traverses reachable blocks, filters selected block IDs and copies each selected content.text in full.
Baseline shared HostAdapter requires exact selection reference set and coverage selectedTextBlocksOnly.
Native host keeps the same document-or-whole-selected-text-block scope and converts native inline Markdown to visible plain text using the pinned canonical parser.
No prior character-subrange Hanlin capability is removed by this adaptation.
